text:
The NMOS common-gate core has no headroom: g1 = Veb + Vgs ≈ 1.44 V at 27 °C, and about 1.67 V at −40 °C. That leaves M4 (and M5, which already has only 66 mV margin) in triode at cold and low VDD. This is the cause of both the 180 ppm/°C TC and the 0.23 V/V line regulation. I'm switching to an op-amp-forced current-mode core with level-shift resistors. The NMOS op-amp inputs sit near 1.0 V. All PMOS sources keep more than 0.6 V of Vsd at every corner, and the output mirror tracks the core in Vsd.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "NMOS CG core needs Veb+Vgs≈1.67V at cold, starving M4/M5 of headroom; this causes the TC and line-reg failures. Replace it with an OTA-forced PTAT core. Equal level-shift resistors Rx put the OTA inputs at ~1V, so every PMOS keeps ≥0.6V Vsd. Matched mirrors give low line regulation."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I0":      (4e-6, 2e-6, 8e-6),      # PTAT branch current
    "r21":     (9.8, 8.0, 12.0),        # R2/R1 (PTAT/CTAT balance)
    "gmid_p":  (10, 6, 14),             # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Lp":      (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),         # PMOS mirror L
    "Vsh":     (0.28, 0.18, 0.38),      # level shift I0*Rx (OTA input CM)
    "Iota":    (2e-6, 1e-6, 5e-6),      # OTA tail current
    "gmid_in": (18, 12, 24),            # OTA input pair gm/Id
    "Lin":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),         # OTA input pair L (matching)
    "Cc":      (5e-12, 1e-12, 15e-12),  # dominant-pole cap at pg
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    m3 = 2
    VDD = 1.8
    T = 300.15
    I0 = p["I0"]
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I0
    R2 = p["r21"] * R1
    Rx = p["Vsh"] / I0
    It = p["Iota"]

    # Operating levels (27C)
    veb = 0.76 + UT * math.log(I0 / 10e-6)
    va = veb + p["Vsh"]

    # PMOS current sources (core, output, OTA-tail bias): same gm/Id and L, so equal Vsg
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I0, vds=VDD - va)
    mpb = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], It, vds=VDD - 0.7)
    pg = VDD - mp.vgs

    # OTA: NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load (same gm/Id as the core PMOS, giving pg ~ diode node)
    min_ = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["Lin"], It / 2, vds=0.45, vsb=0.35)
    mld = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=mp.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", 12, 2.0, It, vds=0.35)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # core branch A
    n.dev("MP1", "a", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("RXA", "a", "e1", Rx)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    # core branch B
    n.dev("MP2", "b", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("RXB", "b", "bm", Rx)
    n.R("R1", "bm", "q2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "q2", m=N)
    # OTA: out = pg = drain of MN1 (input a); diode load on the MN2 (input b) side
    n.dev("MN1", "pg", "a", "t", "vss", min_)
    n.dev("MN2", "o2", "b", "t", "vss", min_)
    n.dev("ML2", "o2", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", mld)
    n.dev("ML1", "pg", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", mld)
    n.dev("MT", "t", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # tail bias, self-biased from pg
    n.dev("MP4", "nb", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.dev("MB", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.C("CC", "pg", "vdd", p["Cc"])
    # output branch
    n.dev("MP3", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=m3)
    # start-up: vref low -> s high -> pull pg low
    n.M("MSP", "s", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSK", "s", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MST", "pg", "s", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 0.5)

    # ---------- predictions ----------
    veb3 = veb - UT * math.log(m3)
    VR2 = R2 * I0
    vref = veb3 + VR2
    dvbe = (veb3 - 1.17 - 3 * UT) / T
    dvref = dvbe + VR2 / T
    tc = abs(dvref) / vref * 1e6 + 12.0
    # line reg: mirrors track in Vsd; residual comes from OTA finite gain/PSRR
    gds_id = mp.gm_id / mp.intrinsic_gain
    a_ota = min_.intrinsic_gain / 2
    line_reg = VR2 * gds_id * abs((VDD - vref) - (VDD - va)) * 0 + VR2 * gds_id / max(a_ota, 1) + 2e-3
    i_tot = 3 * I0 + 2 * It + 0.5e-6
    power = VDD * i_tot
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "power": power, "startup_ok": 1}
```

The diagnosis tool will flag MSK in triode and MST off. That is the intended steady state of the start-up circuit, not a fault.

Expected at 27 °C, before simulation:
- **vref:** about 1.21 V.
- **Power:** about 30 µW.
- **TC:** the core PMOS keeps at least 0.7 V of Vsd at −40 °C, so headroom no longer limits it. Any remaining TC should then be tunable through `r21`.
